entry_points.summary: LLM-free CLI; positional <command>; stdout is one JSON envelope; stderr for warnings; exit 0 on any producible envelope (fail-open); exit 1 only when <command> arg is missing
Core estimator: loads profiles, resolves profile for command, computes static + dispatch + empirical tiers, applies static-floor clamp, returns envelope dict

Reads metrics.jsonl tail (bounded), buckets by parent-run, filters to normally-completed runs (terminal event + non-excluded status + no cost_gate_decision{abandon}), computes p50/p90; returns None when insufficient data
Loads token-cost-profiles.json; uses data.get('profiles', {}); warns and returns {} on FileNotFoundError or JSONDecodeError (fail-open)
Match order: exact after stripping '/'; then try prepending 'z-'; returns (canonical_key, profile_dict|None)

Gate driver: estimate → delegate disposition to config.py check-no-ask → render human_block → emit single JSON {disposition, estimate, human_block}; fail-open (estimator/config errors produce fallback envelope/disposition); stdout is pure JSON; stderr for diagnostics

Profile registry: schema_version 1; profiles object keyed by command name (z-research, z-uplift, z-plan-split, z-brainstorm, z-audit, z-debug); each entry: range [low, high], gate hard|soft, optional multipliers {key: per_unit_tokens}
[Cost gate] Enum question_id in DEFAULTS workflow block; default 'ask'; valid values ask|auto_proceed|halt
[Cost gate] Integer budget knob; default None (unset); NOT a question_id; validator: _validate_positive_int_or_none; coercer converts string env values to int

[Cost gate] Registered question_id; choices {ask, auto_proceed, halt}; skill_default ask; callsites: scripts/pre-run-cost-gate.sh, commands/z-research.md, commands/z-uplift.md, commands/z-plan-split.md, commands/z-brainstorm.md, commands/z-audit.md, commands/z-debug.md
[Cost gate] Budget-aware resolver invoked by check-no-ask when --range-high and --severity are both provided; applies overnight envelope first, then budget rule; returns {result, rule_id}

invariants: estimate-tokens.py exits 0 on any producible envelope; exit 1 only when <command> positional arg is missing
Estimator is fail-open: FileNotFoundError on profiles or metrics returns a usable (possibly zeroed) envelope
Static-floor clamp: estimated_tokens = max(static_low + dispatch_add, round(p50)); range_low is never lowered by empirical; range_high = max(static_high + dispatch_add, round(p90))
pre-run-cost-gate.sh stdout is a single JSON object {disposition, estimate, human_block}; all diagnostics go to stderr only
pre-run-cost-gate.sh delegates disposition to config.py check-no-ask (single authority); it never reimplements the budget rule in bash
Soft gate always resolves to auto_proceed (config.py returns auto_proceed for severity=soft regardless of budget/NO_ASK)
Hard gate with Z_HARNESS_NO_ASK=halt and no budget set returns halt (rule_id: cost_budget_missing) — fail-closed
Hard gate with Z_HARNESS_NO_ASK=halt and range_high missing returns halt (rule_id: cost_estimate_missing) — never silently auto_proceeds
budget <= 0 after coercion returns halt (rule_id: cost_budget_invalid); validator should catch it at write time but defense-in-depth applies
cost.token_budget is NOT in QUESTION_IDS; it is a plain config knob; _run_startup_guards() must NOT reference it
workflow.pre_run_cost_gate IS in QUESTION_IDS, VALIDATORS, and RESULT_MAP; _run_startup_guards() asserts this at module load
cost_gate_decision event is emitted by the CALLER (command), not by the gate helper; one event per gate invocation
cost_gate_decision with choice:abandon is the empirical filter signal; those parent runs are excluded from future p50/p90 computation
Gate fires AFTER run_start so cost_gate_decision attributes to the run
Empirical tier excludes: in-flight runs (latest_ts within 5 min of max_ts), terminal status in {aborted_by_user, halted, errored}, runs with cost_gate_decision{choice:abandon}
Parent-run rollup: events bucketed by effective_run = parent_run_id if present else run; child tokens accumulate into parent bucket
Both run_start and run_end top-level events carry a command field (Phase-7 stamping); empirical attribution prefers event command field over kind-inference (_KIND_TO_COMMAND fallback)
Z_HARNESS_COST_TAIL_LINES (default 2000) and Z_HARNESS_COST_MIN_SAMPLES (default 3) control empirical tier behavior via env vars
No-profile envelope: confidence=low, range [0,0], gate=null, basis='no profile', estimated_tokens=0; gate helper treats this as estimate-unavailable
OVERNIGHT_AUTODECIDE_QIDS_DEFAULT does NOT include workflow.pre_run_cost_gate; operators must opt in via OVERNIGHT_AUTODECIDE_EFFECTIVE or direct config
_KIND_TO_COMMAND maps generic run_start/run_end to z-plan as best-effort default for pre-T001 legacy events; pre-T001 z-research events will be misattributed to z-plan
gotchas: Z_HARNESS_COST_TOKEN_BUDGET string env value must coerce to int; the coercer in _COERCERS handles this; if coercion fails at repo/env layer, config.py exits 2 (hard fail, not soft warn)
workflow.pre_run_cost_gate=halt in TOML halts ALL hard-gate commands unconditionally including interactive sessions
--range-high missing in check-no-ask cost-gate path means estimate unavailable: interactive returns ask, overnight returns halt(cost_estimate_missing); never silently auto_proceeds
The brainstorm multiplier in z-research profile assumes a non-HEAVY brainstorm sub-run; HEAVY sub-runs cost more but there is no per-invocation budget override (change-dispatch is the lever)
Soft gates fire only on HEAVY classification path for z-brainstorm and z-audit; LIGHT/MEDIUM runs skip the gate entirely
z-research has a 3-loop-back cap on change_dispatch; if COST_GATE_LOOPBACKS > 3 the gate falls through to Abandon
cost_gate_decision replaces the legacy research_cost_gate_decision event for z-research; do not emit both
empirical token counting uses subagent_input_tokens + subagent_output_tokens; falls back to prompt_chars/4 + response_chars/4; events with neither field contribute 0 tokens
The empirical tier counts ALL events in the parent bucket (including child subagent events); this is intentional — it reflects the full run cost including sub-dispatches
In-flight grace window is 5 minutes (300s): if a run's latest event is within 5 min of the file's global max_ts, it is considered in-flight and excluded regardless of terminal event presence
Token env transliteration: Z_HARNESS_COST_TOKEN_BUDGET (not Z_HARNESS_COST_TOKEN_BUDGET_INT); the coercer produces int from string
config.py QUESTION_IDS callsites list omits z-brainstorm.md, z-audit.md, z-debug.md; all three call pre-run-cost-gate.sh in practice — the source list is the authoritative callsite record

envelope_schema.estimated_tokens: <int; static_low+dispatch when no empirical; max(static_low+dispatch, p50) when empirical>
envelope_schema.range_low: <int; static_low + dispatch_add; never lowered by empirical>
envelope_schema.range_high: <int|null; max(static_high+dispatch, p90) when empirical; null for estimator-unavailable fallback only (not no-profile: no-profile returns 0)>

workflow.pre_run_cost_gate.description: Controls hard-gate AskUser behavior. ask=prompt; auto_proceed=skip prompt; halt=unconditional halt

cost.token_budget.description: Token ceiling for overnight/no-ask hard-gate resolution. range_high <= budget -> auto_proceed; range_high > budget -> halt; unset -> halt(cost_budget_missing)
